events.quote: some common verbs have their own past form, with no -ed: go - went, buy - bought, see - saw
Right: "Last night our cat caught a mouse." Wrong: "Last night our cat catched a mouse."
start each sentence with a capital letter, write I as a capital, and end with a full stop
Right: "Today I saw a big ship." Wrong: "today i saw a big ship"
